text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a TV interview, Inari One declared 
that her next goal was the Japan Dirt 
Derby, which was considered an unexpected 
choice when it aired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the reporters headed to Oi to 
interview the stable master who had 
mentored Inari One before her transfer—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because her ultimate goal and 
reasons for wanting to conquer the 
regional races didn't come across 
properly, Inari One ended up making the 
Boss angry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One, however, made no excuses, 
stating that she would prove her resolve 
through results. Seeing this, her Trainer 
couldn't help but feel uneasy about 
whether this was truly the right approach.
